title: The Great Wave
description: The Queen Regent dreams of a wave swallowing Númenor. Galadriel's demand for an army and an audience with the true king ends with the Elf locked up beside Halbrand.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Pharazôn calms the crowd
description: Anger at the Elf in the palace boils over in the streets. Chancellor Pharazôn turns the mob with a single speech, watched by his son Kemen and by Eärien.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Dismissed from the Sea Guard
description: Isildur lets a line slip on purpose to get himself expelled from the cadets — and drags his friends Valandil and Ontamo down with him.

title: Adar's message
description: Adar turns out to be a scarred Elf whom the Orcs call father. He sends Arondir back to his people with an ultimatum: give up the land and swear fealty, or be destroyed.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The hilt and the mark
description: Foraging in abandoned Tirharad, Theo is hunted by Orcs who want his broken sword; the freed Arondir carries him back to the tower. There old Waldreg shows Theo a matching scar and tells him whose weapon it is.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Elves and Dwarves build the forge
description: Celebrimbor's tower rises with Dwarven help. But Durin has stopped coming, and Elrond goes back under the mountain to find out why.

title: Mithril
description: Elrond discovers what Durin has been hiding below the Mirrormere: a new ore, light as silk and harder than steel. He swears to keep the secret, just as the shaft collapses on the miners.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The King and the palantír
description: Galadriel breaks out and climbs the tower to find the true king, Tar-Palantir, old and bedridden. Míriel shows her the seeing-stone and the doom it foretells — a doom she believes begins with the arrival of an Elf.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Durin is sent to Lindon
description: After the collapse the king closes the mine, but lets his son travel to Lindon with Elrond to learn what the Elves really want.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The White Tree sheds its petals
description: As Galadriel is rowed out to exile, the petals of Nimloth fall — the tears of the Valar. Míriel changes course: Númenor will sail with the Elf to the aid of the Southlands.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com
